quests.title: Boars in the Yam Beds
quests.text: Jungle boars turn up the yam beds outside Kapok by day. Drive off three, and bring spare raw meat to Zemi Sweetroot at the separate oven shelter.

quests.title: Fill the Evening Pot
quests.text: The shared oven feeds everyone returning from kapok's outer paths. Bring four raw meat portions to Zemi Sweetroot beside the oven. Take this provision job before the short local hunt; carried or traded meat counts, and Cooking is not required.

quests.title: A Dry Frame for the Baskets
quests.text: Kapok's dry baskets need a new frame above the wet ground. Bring six junglewood planks for the supports. Ordinary planks from local jungle trunks, existing supplies and traded boards all count.

quests.title: Dead in the Rootways
quests.text: Zombies wander the rootways beyond Kapok after nightfall. Defeat three on level-3-and-up ground. The basket repair and optional tool lessons are available without waiting for the night patrol.

quests.title: Vipers Under Broad Leaves
quests.text: Vipers shelter beneath the broad leaves beside the homes. Clear the nearest nests. Near the start they hunt by day and by night on level-4-and-up ground.

quests.title: The Road to Daro Kapok
quests.text: At level 10, follow the route to Raincall Village and speak with Daro Kapok. Raincall Basin is level 11–20 country; prepare your equipment and avoid wandering into its hunters. Complete this handoff with Daro, with no fighting errand or return trip.

quests.title: A Dry-Handled Axe
quests.text:
Bring a wood axe and Zalima will show how to keep the handle dry and the cut clean.

Open Basics in your Crafting tab to see the wood axe recipe: three planks and two sticks. You can make planks from a tree trunk and sticks from planks. Wood tools are fragile; stone lasts longer and bronze is your first durable upgrade. This lesson is optional; an axe made by a friend is welcome too.

quests.title: Stone Beneath the Moss
quests.text:
Bring a stone pick for a lesson in reading rock beneath moss and root.

Use Basics to make a wooden pick first, then mine stone. The stone pick recipe uses three stone blocks across the top and two sticks down the middle. Keep valuable tools repaired through a profession trainer in a settlement. This lesson is optional; a traded pick counts too.

quests.title: The Pot Before the Rain
quests.text: Zemi Sweetroot has moved the common pot under Kapok's oven shelter before the rain arrives. Bring three coal lumps for the dry fuel basket. Traded supplies count; mining coal yourself only requires a pickaxe; wood and stone picks work too.

quests.title: The Road to Kezamba
quests.text: Kezamba's shrine receives travellers looking for trainers, repairs and the city's public workspaces. At level 10, follow the road to Nalo Pathdrum there. The country around the city is level 20–30; leave its wildlife alone on the journey. Speak with Nalo and complete the introduction at the shrine.
